name: Prime Payment Gateway for Woocommerce
author: primegateway2026

sections.description:
Prime Payment Gateway for WooCommerce allows store owners to accept secure online payments through the Prime payment gateway directly on their WordPress website.
The plugin integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce and follows standard payment gateway practices. It provides a smooth checkout experience for customers while giving merchants full control over payment configuration from the WordPress admin panel.

Both sandbox (test) and live modes are supported, making it easy to test transactions before going live.

Features

  • Seamless WooCommerce checkout integration
  • Secure payment processing via Prime Gateway
  • Sandbox and Live environment support
  • Simple admin configuration
  • Customizable payment title
  • Automatic order status updates
  • Stores transaction ID in WooCommerce order details
  • Handles payment success, failure, and cancellation
  • Compatible with latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions

Configuration

After activation, configure the plugin from:

WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Prime Gateway

Required details:
* Prime API Key
* Prime API Secret
* Environment (Sandbox / Live)
* Payment title and description (optional)

Ensure permalinks are enabled for proper callback handling.

How It Works

  1. Customer selects Prime Payment Gateway at checkout.
  2. Customer is redirected to Prime’s secure payment page.
  3. Payment is processed by Prime.
  4. Customer is redirected back to the WooCommerce order confirmation page.
  5. Order status updates automatically based on payment response.

Security

  • Uses secure HTTPS communication
  • API credentials stored securely in WordPress
  • Payment verification via callback / webhook
  • Prevents duplicate or unauthorized transactions

Support

For support or bug reports, please contact https://primegateway.com/

Disclaimer

This plugin is not affiliated with WooCommerce or WordPress.org. Prime is a third-party payment service provider. Use of the plugin requires acceptance of Prime’s terms and conditions.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  4. Enable Prime Payment Gateway.
  5. Enter your Prime API credentials and save settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a Prime merchant account?

Yes. You must have an active Prime merchant account with valid API credentials.

Does the plugin support refunds?

Refund support depends on Prime Gateway API capabilities.

Can I test payments before going live?

Yes. Sandbox mode is available for testing transactions.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is tested with the latest stable WooCommerce versions.

Does this plugin support subscriptions?

No, subscription payments are not supported unless explicitly enabled by Prime.
